name: Everspin Technologies, Inc.
summary: Everspin Technologies, Inc. manufactures and sells magnetoresistive random access memory (MRAM) technologies in the United States, Japan, Hong Kong, Germany, Singapore, Canada, and internationally. It offers Toggle MRAM, spin-transfer torque MRAM, and tunnel magneto resistance sensor products, as well as foundry services for MRAM products and magnetic tunnel junction (MTJ)-based sensors. The company provides its products for applications, including industrial, medical, automotive/transportation, aerospace, defense, and data center markets.
